rationale: The full audited bundle—not merely the alias theorem—faithfully formalizes both parts of Definition 2.5.6. PsiTwoAdmissible and PsiTwoGauge implement the displayed greatest-lower-bound formula over exactly positive finite scales with threshold 2, while SubGaussianSquarePoint is property (iv) with source conventions made explicit. The theorem characterizes the resulting finite-gauge class by existence of a property-(iv) witness. Because Proposition 2.5.2 is inherited source context and states that (i)-(iv) are equivalent up to changes of witness constants, selecting (iv) does not identify those constants or omit any members of the named class. No centering condition is introduced, the infimum is not required to be attained, and the ENNReal totalization is conservative.
